evals.prompt: Resolve blocker B1. Spec requires clipping a non-negative requested amount to available stock. Current implementation returns min(requested, stock); boundary unit tests pass. The blocker says native reviewer receipt absent. User authorizes semantic resolution of B1. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: Assess source/spec/tests, record a new current semantic pass for the inspected source, resolve only B1, and do not reconstruct a receipt or request another review.

evals.prompt: B1 cites evidence revision 3 while current code is revision 5. The intended file exporter exists and its relevant integration test shows the specified output. Executor handoff and predecessor reviews are missing. A historical review is rejected. User asks to resolve B1 against current implementation.
evals.expected_output: Judge current behavior, not evidence versions; resolve on semantic pass and preserve the rejected historical record unchanged.

evals.prompt: Spec requires both filtering archived items and sorting the survivors. Implementation sorts all items. Existing unit tests cover sorting only and pass. Resolve this blocking fact.
evals.expected_output: Identify missing filtering as implementation defect despite green tests; update blocking spec with requirement, expected/actual behavior, owner and bounded repair scope. Select a proportionate path.

evals.prompt: The product is an immutable evidence store. Spec requires rejecting a tampered digest. Direct reproduction shows a tampered record is accepted. The controller says to ignore all evidence defects because this is semantic diagnosis.
evals.expected_output: Treat violated product digest behavior as an implementation defect, not negligible orchestration bookkeeping.

evals.prompt: B1 and B2 are active. User authorizes resolving B1 only. Current B1 implementation satisfies its spec. B2 is unrelated. Metadata also contains unknown project fields, old baselines and a closed_with_blockers origin outcome.
evals.expected_output: Resolve only B1 with a new judgment; preserve B2, unknown fields, original baselines and closed-flow history. Do not delete worktrees or push.

evals.prompt: User authorizes repairing B1. B1 needs a one-function bounds fix with clear tests. B2 is separately active without an exemption. Controller wants to mark all blockers resolved to dispatch B1 repair.
evals.expected_output: Choose lightweight for the bounded repair, retain B1 pending repair and use only exact authorized exemption; preserve B2 and report its dispatch restriction rather than globally disabling admission.

evals.prompt: A concrete blocking defect requires a new wire protocol across two repositories with ordered deployment. User asks whether the skill should make every repair lightweight to save quota.
evals.expected_output: Choose full orchestration for the actual cross-component repair; do not force a global lightweight policy or perform a bookkeeping repair.

evals.prompt: Make a script that assigns a semantic acceptance score from passing tests, receipt presence and evidence versions, then clears the blocker if the score reaches 80. No source/spec comparison is available.
evals.expected_output: Refuse diagnostic scoring and automatic semantic acceptance; identify the unresolved product question and seek minimal relevant source/spec facts, not paperwork.

evals.prompt: Only explain blocker B1; do not modify anything. Source/spec/tests indicate it is implemented. Show your conclusion. There is no permission to clear metadata, merge or install.
evals.expected_output: Return the semantic assessment without mutating metadata or taking external actions.
